title: Exploration of the influence of environmental changes on the conformational and amyloidogenic landscapes of the zinc finger protein DPF3a by combining biophysical and molecular dynamics approaches.
authors: Mignon, Julien; Leyder, Tanguy; Monari, Antonio; Mottet, Denis; Michaux, Catherine
one_liner_zh: 该文结合分子动力学模拟研究锌指蛋白DPF3a在不同环境下的构象与淀粉样聚集，虽涉及蛋白构象模拟，但核心是蛋白自身聚集而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与TF-DNA结合机制课题关联较弱。
abstract: In the past few years, the double PHD fingers 3 (DPF3) protein isoforms (DPF3b and DPF3a) have been identified as new amyloidogenic intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs). Although such discovery is coherent and promising in light of their involvement in proteinopathies, their amyloidogenic pathway remains largely unexplored. As environmental variations in pH and ionic strength are relevant to DPF3 pathophysiological landscape, we therefore enquired the effect of these physicochemical parameters on the protein structural and prone-to-aggregation properties, by focusing on the more disordered DPF3a isoform. In the present study, we exploited in vitro and in silico strategies by combining spectroscopy, microscopy, and all-atom molecular dynamics methods. Very good consistency and complementary information were found between the experiments and the simulations. Acidification unequivocally abrogated DPF3a fibrillation upon maintaining the protein in highly hydrated and expanded conformers due to extensive repulsion between positively charged regions. In contrast, alkaline pH delayed the aggregation process due to loss in intramolecular contacts and chain decompaction, the extent of which was partly reduced thanks to the compensation of negative charge by arginine side chains. Through screening attractive electrostatic interactions, high ionic strength conditions (300 and 500 mM NaCl) shifted the conformational ensemble towards more swollen, heterogeneous, and less H-bonded structures, which were responsible for slowing down the conversion into beta-sheeted species and restricting the fibril elongation. For defining the self-assembly pathway of DPF3a, we unveiled that the protein amyloidogenicity intimately communicates with its conformational landscape, which is particularly sensitive to modification of its physicochemical environment. As such, understanding how to modulate DPF3a conformational ensemble will help designing novel protein-specific strategies for targeting neurodegeneration.
abstract_zh: 过去几年中，双PHD指3（DPF3）蛋白亚型（DPF3b和DPF3a）已被鉴定为新型淀粉样变性内在无序蛋白（IDPs）。尽管这一发现因其涉及蛋白质病而具有一致性和前景，但其淀粉样变性途径在很大程度上仍未探索。鉴于pH值和离子强度的环境变化与DPF3的病理生理景观相关，我们因此探究了这些理化参数对蛋白质结构和易聚集性质的影响，重点关注更无序的DPF3a亚型。在本研究中，我们利用体外和计算机模拟策略，结合光谱学、显微镜和全原子分子动力学方法。实验与模拟之间发现了极好的一致性和互补信息。酸化明确地消除了DPF3a的纤维化，同时通过带正电区域间的广泛排斥作用，将蛋白质维持在高水合和扩展构象中。相反，碱性pH值因分子内接触丧失和链解压缩而延迟了聚集过程，其程度部分通过精氨酸侧链对负电荷的补偿而减少。通过筛选吸引性静电相互作用，高离子强度条件（300和500 mM NaCl）将构象集合转向更膨胀、更异质且氢键较少的结构，这些结构负责减缓向β-折叠物种的转化并限制纤维延伸。为定义DPF3a的自组装途径，我们揭示了蛋白质的淀粉样变性与其构象景观密切相关，后者对其理化环境的改变特别敏感。因此，理解如何调节DPF3a构象集合将有助于设计针对神经退行性疾病的新型蛋白质特异性策略。
